request.report:
Closed milestone M1 (n-gram self-speculation). Validated every acceptance criterion against the replay artifacts and closed the site/documentation loop.

Work done this session:
1. Verified all 5 replay config dirs (off-greedy, A-greedy, B-greedy, off-prod, A-prod) each contain requests.jsonl, vram.txt, notes.txt, and all four per-phase server logs. Confirmed per-phase row counts are complete (30 agent fg + 12 mem fg + bg loops in each phase).
2. Confirmed all 171 foreground rows in A-greedy and B-greedy carry draft_n/draft_n_accepted with zero missing fields (missing field = 0 drafted per server-common.cpp:82-85).
3. Confirmed mmproj/embedded-batch verdict is documented in bench/m1-notes.md (§3 + §4).
4. Site metadata: PyYAML is unavailable in the sandbox and pip install fails (no CA cert bundle), so tools/check_site.py could not run directly. Wrote and ran a pure-Python mirror of its checks (required frontmatter fields, 200-word summary limit, series reference, updated-date staleness): 10 pages checked, 0 errors. Frontmatter dates are current (updated: 2026-10-12) across the experiment page, serving series index, and project index.
5. Appended journal round 10 to autopilot/state/M1-ngram/journal.md documenting the closure and validation method.

Decision: no-deploy. No infra request was made and the live bonsai-2-27b entry is unchanged (confirmed no --spec-* flag in serving/llama-swap.bonsai-2-27b.yaml). The no-deploy decision plus the deferred per-role KV-precision note are carried into the experiment page (status: done), series index, and project index.

Milestone complete.
